meta.name: Athidhi
meta.description:
Unexpected guests enter a loner's house and life, unleashing a series of horrific events. Everyone becomes a suspect and a victim.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: Strange Beauty
videos.overview: YouTuber Savari is looking for Dayyala Mitta, a haunted place. Ravi Varma meets a woman who resembles a character from one of his books - Maya.

videos.title: Two Short Stories
videos.overview: Spooked by the deserted road, Savari seeks refuge in Ravi's house. There he comes across Ravi's unfinished book, an anthology of short stories.

videos.title: The Murder
videos.overview: As Ravi narrates his stories, Savari's suspicion of Maya is confirmed during a power outage. The situation worsens when someone knocks on the door.

videos.title: Back and Forth
videos.overview: Savari is stunned to see who the strangers are. They threaten him to join their illegal activities. Greedy for more, they return to Ravi's house.

videos.title: The Key Factor
videos.overview: The unwanted guests torture Ravi for a locker room key. What happens next lands them in an inescapable situation.

videos.title: Arishadvarga
videos.overview: The truth unfolds, and the life of a king is brought to light. As karmic paths are revealed, the sinners get their comeuppance.
